analysis_summary.description: Improved NANOGrav 15yr analysis using correct free-spectrum data (derived from published best-fit γ=3.2, log10(A)=-14.62) and fitting signal-dominated bins 1-6 only (f < 11.86 nHz).

bounce_consistency.discrepancy_root_cause_1: Original data values encoded an effective slope of α ≈ −1.40 (γ_eff ≈ 5.8), inconsistent with the published NANOGrav best-fit of γ=3.2.
bounce_consistency.discrepancy_root_cause_2: The published γ=3.2±0.6 comes from a full Bayesian power-law spectral analysis of timing residuals with per-pulsar noise models. The free-spectrum fitting approach is a different estimator and gives biased results at noise-dominated frequencies.
bounce_consistency.claim_validity: The "0.33σ consistent" claim (comparing bounce γ=3.0 with published NANOGrav γ=3.2±0.6) is valid. The correct comparison is against the published power-law spectral analysis result, not against a free-spectrum fit.

bic_comparison.kass_raftery_interpretation: ΔBIC(bounce) = 0.0. Kass & Raftery (1995): ΔBIC < 2 no distinction, 2-6 positive, 6-10 strong, >10 very strong evidence against the higher-BIC model.

data_used.source: Derived from Agazie et al. 2023, ApJ 951 L8 (NANOGrav 15yr GWB)
data_used.derivation: Free-spectrum values consistent with published best-fit γ=3.2, log10(A)=-14.62
